map.依据 KDIGO 标准，通过血肌酐变化倍数与尿量评估急性肾损伤分期（1/2/3: Based on KDIGO criteria, assess the acute kidney injury stage (stage 1/2/3) through the fold change of serum creatinine and urine output.
map.依据 KDIGO 2012 AKI 指南，满足任一即诊断：48h 内血肌酐（Sc: Based on the KDIGO 2012 AKI guideline, the diagnosis is met if any one is satisfied: serum creatinine (Scr) rises ≥0.3 mg/dL within 48h; or Scr rises to ≥1.5 times baseline within 7d; or urine output <0.5 mL/kg/h for 6h. The stage is the most severe of:
map.=Scr ≥3.0× 或 ≥4.0 mg/dL 或尿量＜0.3 持续 24h/无: =Scr ≥3.0× baseline or ≥4.0 mg/dL or urine output <0.3 for 24h / anuria for 12h.
map.无基线 Scr 时用人群估算公式反推（如基于 eGFR）。: When no baseline Scr is available, back-calculate with a population estimation formula (e.g. based on eGFR).
map.本工具仅供临床参考，不能替代医师判断与实验室复核。: This tool is for clinical reference only and cannot replace physician judgment and laboratory review.

map.KDIGO 急性肾损伤分期标准: KDIGO acute kidney injury staging criteria
map.升至基线 1.5-1.9 倍 或 升高 ≥26.5 μmol/L: Rises to 1.5-1.9× baseline or rises ≥26.5 μmol/L
map.升至基线 ≥3.0 倍 或 ≥353.6 μmol/L 或 开始 RRT: Rises to ≥3.0× baseline or ≥353.6 μmol/L or RRT started
map.取血肌酐与尿量两者中较严重的一项作为最终分期。: Take the more severe of the serum creatinine and urine output criteria as the final stage.
map.⚠️ AKI 诊断需 48h 内肌酐升高 ≥26.5 μmol/L 或 7 天内: ⚠️ AKI diagnosis requires Scr rising ≥26.5 μmol/L within 48h or rising to 1.5× baseline within 7 days. This tool only assists staging and does not replace clinical judgment.
